metadata.question: Was the vegetation cover near the Damietta branch of the Nile mouth greater in 1984 than in 2021?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use Landsat imagery (Landsat 5 TM for 1984, Landsat 8/9 for 2021) around the Damietta branch of the Nile mouth. Damietta is ~31.4°N, 31.8°E. Use a 10 km buffer around a point there. 2. Masking: Mask clouds and water (NDVI works on land). 3. Index: NDVI to represent vegetation cover. 4. Comparison: Compute mean NDVI for 1984-01-01..1984-12-31 and 2021-01-01..2021-12-31. 5. Check for C1 (no images), C2 (no valid pixels after masking), C3 (None/NaN), otherwise A/B. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time Definitions pt = ee.Geometry.Point([31.8, 31.4]) # Damietta branch mouth roi = pt.buffer(10000) yr1984 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2') \ .filterDate('1984-01-01', '1984-12-31') \ .filterBounds(roi) yr2021 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') \ .filterDate('2021-01-01', '2021-12-31') \ .filterBounds(roi) # 2. Data Acquisition & Check if yr1984.size().getInfo() == 0: print("1984: C1") print("C1") exit() if yr2021.size().getInfo() == 0: print("2021: C1") print("C1") exit() # 3. Cloud/water mask and NDVI def maskLandsat(img): qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL') cloud = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).Or(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 5)) water = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 7) return img.updateMask(cloud.Not()).updateMask(water.Not()) \ .normalizedDifference(['SR_B4','SR_B3']).rename('NDVI') ndvi84 = yr1984.map(maskLandsat).mean().clip(roi) ndvi21 = yr2021.map(maskLandsat).mean().clip(roi) # 4. Pixel counts and means sum84 = ndvi84.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=roi, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('NDVI').getInfo() sum21 = ndvi21.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=roi, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('NDVI').getInfo() cnt84 = ndvi84.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=roi, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('NDVI').getInfo() cnt21 = ndvi21.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=roi, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('NDVI').getInfo() # 5. Validation & Final Answer if cnt84 == 0 or cnt21 == 0: print("No valid pixels.") print("C2") elif sum84 is None or sum21 is None: print("Calculation failed.") print("C3") else: mean84 = sum84/cnt84 mean21 = sum21/cnt21 print(f"1984 NDVI: {mean84:.3f}, Pixels: {int(cnt84)}") print(f"2021 NDVI: {mean21:.3f}, Pixels: {int(cnt21)}") print("A" if mean84 > mean21 else "B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
pt = ee.Geometry.Point([31.8, 31.4])  # Damietta branch mouth
roi = pt.buffer(10000)

yr1984 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2') \
            .filterDate('1984-01-01', '1984-12-31') \
            .filterBounds(roi)
yr2021 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') \
            .filterDate('2021-01-01', '2021-12-31') \
            .filterBounds(roi)

# 2. Data Acquisition & Check
if yr1984.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("1984: C1")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    exit()
if yr2021.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("2021: C1")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    exit()

# 3. Cloud/water mask and NDVI
def maskLandsat(img):
    qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL')
    cloud = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).Or(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 5))
    water = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 7)
    return img.updateMask(cloud.Not()).updateMask(water.Not()) \
              .normalizedDifference(['SR_B4','SR_B3']).rename('NDVI')

ndvi84 = yr1984.map(maskLandsat).mean().clip(roi)
ndvi21 = yr2021.map(maskLandsat).mean().clip(roi)

# 4. Pixel counts and means
sum84 = ndvi84.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=roi, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('NDVI').getInfo()
sum21 = ndvi21.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=roi, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('NDVI').getInfo()
cnt84 = ndvi84.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=roi, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('NDVI').getInfo()
cnt21 = ndvi21.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=roi, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('NDVI').getInfo()

# 5. Validation & Final Answer
if cnt84 == 0 or cnt21 == 0:
    print("No valid pixels.")
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
elif sum84 is None or sum21 is None:
    print("Calculation failed.")
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
else:
    mean84 = sum84/cnt84
    mean21 = sum21/cnt21
    print(f"1984 NDVI: {mean84:.3f}, Pixels: {int(cnt84)}")
    print(f"2021 NDVI: {mean21:.3f}, Pixels: {int(cnt21)}")
    print("<answer>A</answer>" if mean84 > mean21 else "<answer>B</answer>")
